findings:
🔴 [gate-exit0-on-fix-then-ship] MUST-FIX scripts/check-phase-review-receipt.js Mode A only requires receipt.verdict to MATCH the re-derived verdict, then exits 0 — a finalized FIX-THEN-SHIP receipt (verified Critical still open) passes, while dev-flow L-4's gate criterion is exactly "check-phase-review-receipt exits 0 (SHIP-AS-IS chain or explicit opt-out)", so a phase advances with a confirmed blocker; e2e test case 12 explicitly blesses exit 0 for the FIX-THEN-SHIP receipt (s0 verified-Critical → finalize → checker rc 0), a fixture that passes with the verdict gate deleted. Smallest remediation: require recomputedVerdict === 'SHIP-AS-IS' (else exit 1) and rebuild case 12's positive assertion on a clean SHIP-AS-IS generation.
🔴 [mode-a-malformed-artifact-fail-open] MUST-FIX Mode A re-derivation coerces malformed artifacts to empty (`Array.isArray(findingsData.findings) ? … : []`, same for dispositions) and silently skips the open_findings check when the field is neither array nor number; findings.json is not hash-bound anywhere (only dispositions carry a sha in the chain), so an implementer rewrites g<n>/findings.json to `{}` after finalize — re-derivation sees zero findings and a forged SHIP-AS-IS receipt exits 0, the exact receipt-forgery path the spec asks about. Smallest remediation: mirror finalize's strict validation in Mode A (object with findings array, unique non-empty string ids, severity ∈ {Critical,Major,Minor,Suggestion}, receipt.open_findings must be an array) and exit 1 on any violation.
🟠 [chain-trusted-from-receipt] MUST-FIX Mode A anchors only chainOnDisk[0].base against --phase-base, then iterates receipt.chain for statuses, base/head and dispositions_sha256 — the receipt's own copy is the authority for which generations are finalized and their digests, an ADR-0001 claim-trust the canonical chain should own. Smallest remediation: iterate chainOnDisk (or reject unless receipt.chain deep-equals the on-disk chain.json) so chain metadata cannot be selected by the receipt author.
🟠 [collect-parse-fail-closed-conditional] MUST-FIP-closed check: hetero-review-loop.js collect fails closed on non-empty unparseable findings only when verdict === 'FIX-THEN-SHIP', accepts FIX-THEN-SHIP with an empty findings string as a clean reviewed seat (blocker claim silently dropped → finalize can emit SHIP-AS-IS), and accepts a SHIP-AS-IS seat with ANY unparseable text plus any no_finding_proof string with zero findings — the spec requires unconditional fail-closed on non-empty unparseable findings (the adjudicated exception is only the literal "none" placeholder with proof). Smallest remediation: abort parse_failed for any non-empty text yielding zero findings except the "none" placeholder with proof, and record no_verdict/abort when verdict === 'FIX-THEN-SHIP' and extracted.length === 0.
🟠 [hetero-auto-doc-drift] MUST-FIX the shipped contract rows (project-config-template/review-loop-config.md, hetero-loops.md, level-front-door.md) state hetero_review `auto` "expands tuple from ~/.autopilot/topology.json", but the resolver only stamps hetero_review_resolved_from and leaves reviewer_* unchanged (resolve-review-loop.test.sh blesses "reviewer_engine is UNCHANGED when hetero_review resolves from topology") — a consumer reading resolved_from: topology believes the reviewer seat came from topology while the config/native reviewer runs. Smallest remediation: either correct the hetero_review row/Gotcha to "provenance-only, reviewer_* unchanged" or expand reviewer_* from reviewer_ladder[0] mirroring the consult branch.
🟡 [devflow-gate-command-missing-phase-base] MUST-FIX skills/dev-flow/SKILL.md and skills/dev-flow/references/hetero-loops.md L-4 gate commands invoke check-phase-review-receipt.js without the mandatory --phase-base flag, so the documented invocation always exits 1 ("Review mode requires mandatory --phase-base") and the L-4 checklist can never pass as written. Smallest remediation: add `--phase-base <sha>` to both command strings.
🟡 [role-enum-unvalidated] MUST-FIX scripts/resolve-dispatch-topology.js accumulates --role tokens into selectedRoles without any VALID_ROLES membership check, so a typo like `--role reviewr` exits 0 with a metadata-only topology and every ladder silently absent despite the frozen five-value enum. Smallest remediation: reject any role token outside VALID_ROLES with a usage error (exit 2).
🟡 [vacuous-warning-assertions] MUST-FIX dispatch-consult-hermetic.test.sh asserts `assert_contains "$RESOLVER_JSON" "consult_dispatch"` and the D1-2c matrix asserts the substring "capability_warnings" — both are JSON key names always present in resolver output, so these assertions pass with the native-fallback warning push deleted (fixtures that pass with the gate deleted). Smallest remediation: assert the warning text (e.g. "no qualified consult seat") or parse capability_warnings and check the entry exists.
🔵 [backlog-adjudicated-hardening] CUT/FOLLOW-UP chain.json append locking, opt-out knob regex `*->` range, STUB_SEAT_ID env seam, closure-by-absence semantics, opt-out empty-config-path hash, agy-alias qc-exclusion match, and stale topology-cache native-fallback are already adjudicated CUT/FOLLOW-UP with docs/BACKLOG.md rows (2026-09-04) and no gate decision depends on them — excluded per the spec's handled-downstream rule.
🔵 [qc-pending-placeholder] CUT/FOLLOW-UP the CHANGELOG `<<QC-PENDING>>` literal is the pending D5 three-seat QC slot (project README marks D5 in flight); it is filled by the release deliverable, outside this diff's D1/D2/D2-repair/D4 scope.
🔵 [mode-b-and-test-portability] CUT/FOLLOW-UP Mode B dispositions map builds last-wins on duplicate ids and several test `node -e` snippets use bare `fs`/`crypto` globals without require — hardening/portability nits on depth-0-owned inputs whose suites are recorded green; tighten at next touch.
